verdict.rationale: Netlify documents a REST API (netlify-docs-14), but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. A probe of common OpenAPI and Swagger paths on docs.netlify.com returned 404 at every location. The llms.txt file is documentation for LLMs, not an API specification, so it does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
